# 1. Branch and Stack Summary

- Active branch status: `ChuongBD` at `5e9d68b0`; dirty working tree with 9 pre-existing status entries.
- Local `dev` exists: Yes; `dev` resolves to `5e9d68b0` and matches current HEAD: Yes.
- Backend stack: Java 21, Spring Boot MVC/Security/Data JPA/Flyway plus Python FastAPI sidecars.
- Frontend stack: React 19, Vite, Axios, TanStack Query.
- Mobile stack: Flutter/Dart with a shared HTTP API client.
- DB/auth stack: PostgreSQL/Supabase runtime, JWT bearer authentication, Firebase integrations, BCrypt.
- Key notes: 108 Spring controller files yielded 429 unique route rows; sidecars add 7 routes. Live sheet has 428 cases. No sheet structure was changed.

# 6. Auth and Header Evidence Table

| Module / Endpoint Family | Auth Type | Required Headers | Role Restriction Clue | Source File | Confidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Auth registration/login/OTP/refresh/password reset/lock appeal | Public | Accept: application/json; Content-Type: application/json | Public allowlist in SecurityConfig | SecurityConfig.java; AuthController.java | HIGH |
| All other /api/v1/** | Bearer Token | Authorization: Bearer <token>; Accept: application/json; Content-Type: application/json when a body exists | Authenticated catch-all; method-level @PreAuthorize may narrow roles | SecurityConfig.java; JwtAuthenticationFilter.java | HIGH |
| Admin audit | Bearer Token / Role-Protected | Authorization: Bearer <token> | SYSTEM_ADMIN or OPERATIONS | SecurityConfig.java; audit controllers | HIGH |

# CareBridge Integration Test API Evidence Catalog

> Generated from the live Integration Test workbook export, local `dev` source at `5e9d68b0`, and the checked-in Postman collection. This is an execution guide, not proof of execution. Never paste real passwords, tokens, OTPs, patient data, or provider keys into screenshots.

# 13. Critical Findings

- Strongest code-backed modules: all ten existing functional tabs have current controller/API evidence; mapped route counts are MF01=44, MF02=86, MF03=30, MF04=28, MF05=44, MF06=32, MF07=15, MF08=33, MF09=62, MF10=12.
- Missing or unclear modules: 50 route rows could not be safely mapped to one of the current ten tabs and remain `NEEDS_CONFIRMATION`.
- Endpoint mismatch: four live profile cases are backed by a checked-in Postman request using `/api/v1/profile/me`, but current `ProfileController` exposes `GET /api/v1/profile`; the Evidence catalog uses the current code-backed route and flags the collection as stale.
- Base URL uncertainty: local URLs are proved; deployed public hostname remains environment-controlled and must be confirmed before Postman execution.
- Payload uncertainty: collection bodies are retained only where present; absent or non-JSON bodies are explicitly marked rather than inferred.
- Risks for Postman-based evidence: 46 of 428 cases lack an exact client caller match; external providers, asynchronous jobs, IDs, tokens, and disposable database state must be prepared before execution.
- Tabs to prioritize first: MF01 authentication/access, MF06 triage safety, MF10 safety/emergency, MF08 family privacy, then remaining CRUD/content journeys.
- The remote Genspark file endpoints were not directly retrievable in this environment; the checked-in local Report 1 and Report 3 files were used as document context, while code remained authoritative.
